scope.summary: Implement the micro/detail normal layer with region masks plus cavity/specular-occlusion support (spec 13.22; PREQ-002/003): tiling detail normals with per-region tiling scale and intensity, a cavity map slot modulating specular for real-time lanes, and correct normal-blending math through the layer-stack flatten.
acceptance_criteria: Tiling detail-normal layer with region masks: per-region tiling scale and intensity (the nose-oilier/lips-glossier MetaHuman pattern applied body-wide including genital/areola regions) composing under the layer stack (PREQ-002).
Cavity/specular-occlusion map slot: baked or authored cavity modulates specular in real-time lanes where true displacement is absent (PREQ-003).
Detail layer survives the MT-564 flatten with documented normal-blending math (RNM/UDN choice recorded and tested).
Region-mask edits re-composite without touching source maps (non-destructive proof).
scope.risk_if_missed: Real-time lanes lacking true displacement rely on cavity and detail normals to sell pores (PREQ-003); without masked detail layers, skin reads uniformly plastic at closeup distance in every game-lane export.

gui_obligation.not_applicable_reason: Backend/solver scope: behavior is observable via TraceProjection, typed TAILOR_BODY_* receipts, and the 13.12 capture APIs; operator/model GUI exposure rides the BodyKit panes (13.27) and is validated there.

hbr_int_009_tier_obligations.reason: Emits/extends the TAILOR_BODY_* KernelEventType family on the EventLedger per Section 13.16 (extends the 13.14 canonical list).
internal_diagnostics ships with WP-KERNEL-012; wire the open diagnostic-event API for this behavior in the WP-KERNEL-016 retrofit.
Palmistry external watcher ships with WP-KERNEL-012/016; long generation/bake/export runs get child-stall watch coverage in the retrofit.

risks: Broad MT scope can hide multiple review targets.
Markdown MT lists may disagree with packet-declared active/next MT truth.
Receipt routing may target an old MT if contract identity is omitted.
minimum_controls: Exactly one primary proof target per MT unless the packet records why not.
MT identity must be stable and referenced by receipt correlation.
Generated projection drift must not wake Coder or Validator by itself.
